cleanup: DELETE FROM shadow_eval_samples WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM shadow_eval_samples ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT -1 OFFSET 2000)
DELETE FROM shadow_eval_results WHERE created_at <= :result_cutoff OR id IN (SELECT id FROM shadow_eval_results ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT -1 OFFSET 10000)
config_get: SELECT document FROM shadow_eval_config WHERE id = 1
config_seed: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO shadow_eval_config (id, document) VALUES (1, :document)
config_save: UPDATE shadow_eval_config SET document = :document WHERE id = 1 AND document = :expected
put: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO shadow_eval_samples (id, created_at, document) VALUES (:id, :created_at, :document)
DELETE FROM shadow_eval_samples WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM shadow_eval_samples ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT -1 OFFSET 2000)
sample: SELECT document FROM shadow_eval_samples WHERE id = :id AND created_at > :cutoff
samples: SELECT id, created_at, json_extract(document, '$.route') AS route, json_extract(document, '$.task_type') AS task_type, json_extract(document, '$.production_model') AS production_model FROM shadow_eval_samples WHERE created_at > :cutoff ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 20
pending: SELECT document FROM shadow_eval_samples s WHERE s.created_at > :cutoff AND json_extract(s.document, '$.task_type') = :task AND json_extract(s.document, '$.production_model') != :candidate AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shadow_eval_results r WHERE r.sample_id = s.id AND r.candidate = :candidate) ORDER BY s.created_at, s.id LIMIT 1
lease: UPDATE shadow_eval_config SET lease_until = :until, lease_owner = :run_id WHERE id = 1 AND lease_until <= :now AND json_extract(document, '$.enabled') = 1
release: UPDATE shadow_eval_config SET lease_until = 0, lease_owner = NULL WHERE id = 1 AND lease_owner = :run_id
claim:
UPDATE shadow_eval_config SET day = :day,
replay_count = CASE WHEN day = :day THEN replay_count + 1 ELSE 1 END
WHERE id = 1 AND document = :config AND lease_owner = :run_id AND lease_until > :now
AND json_extract(document, '$.enabled') = 1
AND CASE WHEN day = :day THEN replay_count ELSE 0 END < json_extract(document, '$.daily_cap')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shadow_eval_samples WHERE id = :sample_id AND created_at > :cutoff)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shadow_eval_results WHERE sample_id = :sample_id AND candidate = :candidate) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shadow_eval_samples s,
json_each(shadow_eval_config.document, '$.candidate_models.' || json_extract(s.document, '$.task_type')) m
WHERE s.id = :sample_id AND m.value = :candidate)

INSERT INTO shadow_eval_results (id, sample_id, candidate, created_at)
SELECT :id, :sample_id, :candidate, :now WHERE changes() = 1
DELETE FROM shadow_eval_results WHERE created_at <= :result_cutoff OR id IN (SELECT id FROM shadow_eval_results ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT -1 OFFSET 10000)
finish: UPDATE shadow_eval_results SET document = :document WHERE id = :id AND document IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shadow_eval_samples WHERE id = sample_id AND created_at > :cutoff)
results: SELECT id, created_at, document FROM shadow_eval_results WHERE id > :after AND document IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 50
apply:
INSERT INTO shadow_eval_policy_backups (id, created_at, document)
SELECT :id, :now, document FROM intelligence_policy WHERE id = 1 AND document = :expected

UPDATE intelligence_policy SET document = :document WHERE id = 1 AND document = :expected
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shadow_eval_policy_backups WHERE id = :id AND document = :expected)
DELETE FROM shadow_eval_policy_backups WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM shadow_eval_policy_backups ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT -1 OFFSET 20)
